DO NOT WRITE IN ANY BARCODES. There are forty questions on this paper. Answer all questions. For each question there are four possible answers A, B, C and D. Choose the one you consider correct and record your choice in soft pencil on the separate Answer Sheet. Read the instructions on the Answer Sheet very carefully. Each correct answer will score one mark. A mark will not be deducted for a wrong answer. Any rough working should be done in this booklet. Electronic calculators may be used.

questions.questionText: Measurements of the stem of a young tree showed that the diameter varied slightly. It decreased during the day and increased during the night. Which statement explains these observations?

options.A: During the day, cohesion between water molecules and lignin in the walls of the xylem vessels pulls the walls of the vessels inwards.
options.B: During the day, the tension developed in a moving column of water molecules reduces the pressure inside the xylem vessels, so that their walls move inwards.
options.C: During the night, the adhesion of water molecules to the lignin in the walls of the xylem vessels pushes the walls of the vessels outwards.
options.D: During the night, the pressure of the column of water molecules adhering to one another increases and pushes the walls of the xylem vessels outwards.
